scope: Completed whole-model HF arithmetic and schedule sensitivity diagnostic for Q2 Rome17. Diagnostic evidence only: no reference substitution, new numerical threshold, product change, or Q2 gate pass.

fixed_inputs.model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B Q2_0 released GGUF; 196 Q2_0 Linear tensors, Q4_K embedding, Q6_K output head
fixed_inputs.prompt: Frozen 17-token Rome17 prompt from q2-rome-layer-cut-v1 fixture prompts[5]
fixed_inputs.linear_inputs: Same independent block16 half-away reconstruction over 32-value blocks for all 197 Linear calls, including the output head
fixed_inputs.kv: F16 round-widen in all three variants

diagnostic_variants.name: full-f32-reproduction
diagnostic_variants.purpose: Control; one 17-token call with ordinary HF F32 Linear accumulation

diagnostic_variants.name: singleton-f32
diagnostic_variants.purpose: Schedule sensitivity; 17 one-token calls sharing the logical cache, ordinary HF F32 Linear accumulation

diagnostic_variants.name: full-f64-linear
diagnostic_variants.purpose: Accumulation sensitivity only; each Linear computes input/weight/bias in F64 and casts output to F32, one 17-token call

runtime_comparison.observer_control: The without-observer file is the same Q2 baseline runtime capture, not a Q4 result.
runtime_comparison.interpretation: The Q2 runtime remains 4/5 against the retained full-F32 HF control under the existing rule. Matching the diagnostic F64 Linear control at 5/5 does not make that diagnostic a reference and does not pass Q2. These controls show arithmetic/schedule sensitivity; they do not disprove a runtime defect.

retained_q4_cli_rank_controls.precision: Retained CLI top-ten values printed to six decimal places; these are not full-vocabulary F32 logit captures.
retained_q4_cli_rank_controls.interpretation: These authentic main/candidate Q4 CLI controls add context for schedule and arithmetic sensitivity; their comparison precision is limited to retained six-decimal top-ten rows, and they do not replace the full-F32 HF control or waive the Q2 runtime result.

separate_continuous_nll_evidence.observation: Selected-policy HF full versus singleton differed by 0.0237900000688 mean NLL, above the unchanged 0.01 bound without runtime involvement.
separate_continuous_nll_evidence.relationship: Earlier, separate continuous-NLL diagnostic; not a result from the Rome17 ranking run above.

next_interpretation: Use the pinned whole-model schedule and accumulation controls to distinguish acceptable reference/arithmetic sensitivity from a runtime defect. Keep the selected reference, rule and gate unchanged until the discrepancy is resolved.
